root_review_note.checked: Root read complete A/B and original limitations/pharmacokinetic discussion.
root_review_note.planning_caution: Useful as a cross-treatment comparator and confounding caution. Do not treat the TKI associations or CYP3A4 discussion as direct evidence of microbiome-mediated ICI effects; avoid the unsupported claim that pharmacokinetic interactions matter more to ICI than TKI. Some proposed uses are broader than the measured study.
strengths: Correctly identifies TKI rather than ICI therapy, retrospective design, unresolved infection confounding, and absent direct microbial analysis.
